blocks.note: Build tense and mood forms, including future clusters and the substitute infinitive.
Place finite auxiliaries before modal infinitive clusters in subordinate clauses.
Distinguish learned mastery with können from familiarity and factual knowledge.
Choose modal auxiliaries from force, evidence and source after all six have been taught.
Produce complete German sentences that preserve permission, necessity, ability and likelihood.
Contrast expectation, report and claim, then recast paraphrases as scoped modal constructions.
